sentences.l2: 近年来，许多国家开始通过立法限制使用一次性塑料制品，这是全球趋势的一部分。
sentences.l1: In recent years, many countries have begun to limit the use of single-use plastic products through legislation, and this is part of a global trend.

sentences.l2: 这些环境政策的目标是减少塑料污染，保护自然资源。
sentences.l1: The goal of these environmental policies is to reduce plastic pollution and protect natural resources.

sentences.l2: 不同国家采取了不同的监管方法。
sentences.l1: Different countries have adopted different regulatory methods.

sentences.l2: 有些国家禁止超市免费提供塑料袋，人们需要付费购买，这样可以减少使用量。
sentences.l1: Some countries forbid supermarkets from providing plastic bags for free, and people need to pay to buy them, which can reduce the amount used.

sentences.l2: 另一些国家完全禁止某些塑料产品，比如塑料吸管和餐具。
sentences.l1: Other countries completely ban certain plastic products, such as plastic straws and tableware.

sentences.l2: 政府还会对制造塑料的企业征税，鼓励它们改用环保材料。
sentences.l1: The government will also tax companies that make plastic, encouraging them to switch to environmentally friendly materials.

sentences.l2: 在欧洲，一些国家推行“塑料瓶押金制度”。
sentences.l1: In Europe, some countries have introduced a "plastic bottle deposit system".

sentences.l2: 顾客买饮料时多付一点钱，归还空瓶后可以拿回押金。
sentences.l1: When customers buy drinks, they pay a little extra, and after returning the empty bottle they can get the deposit back.

sentences.l2: 这个方法让塑料瓶的回收率大幅提高。
sentences.l1: This method has greatly increased the recycling rate of plastic bottles.

sentences.l2: 亚洲一些城市则加强垃圾分类管理，规定居民必须把塑料垃圾分开投放，否则会被罚款。
sentences.l1: Some cities in Asia, on the other hand, have strengthened waste sorting management, stipulating that residents must put plastic waste out separately, otherwise they will be fined.

sentences.l2: 这些措施虽然有时给生活带来不便，但长期来看对环境有益。
sentences.l1: Although these measures sometimes bring inconvenience to life, in the long run they are beneficial to the environment.

sentences.l2: 虽然各国政策不同，但目的都是减少塑料垃圾。
sentences.l1: Although countries' policies differ, their aim is all to reduce plastic waste.

sentences.l2: 科学家指出，塑料在自然环境中很难分解，会对海洋生物造成伤害。
sentences.l1: Scientists point out that plastic is very hard to break down in the natural environment and will cause harm to marine life.

sentences.l2: 因此，越来越多的国家加入这个行动。
sentences.l1: Therefore, more and more countries are joining this action.

sentences.l2: 专家认为，有效的监管需要政府、企业和公众共同努力。
sentences.l1: Experts believe that effective regulation requires the joint effort of the government, businesses and the public.

sentences.l2: 只有大家合作，才能真正解决塑料污染问题。
sentences.l1: Only if everyone cooperates can the problem of plastic pollution be truly solved.

sentences.l2: 这种全球趋势也提醒我们，保护环境是每个人的责任。
sentences.l1: This global trend also reminds us that protecting the environment is everyone's responsibility.

sentences.l2: 未来可能会有更严格的法律出台，推动社会向更可持续的方向发展。
sentences.l1: In future there may be stricter laws introduced, pushing society to develop in a more sustainable direction.
